title: The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, August 14, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, August 14, 2018 Posted by admin on August 14th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL). up +77 points.
Monday the Dow was down -125.44 (-0.50%) at 25,187.70.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +1.90%.
There were 6 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Merck (MRK) +0.98% and Apple (AAPL) +0.65%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by DowDuPont (DWDP) -1.70% and JPMorgan (JPM) -1.59%.
Home Depot (HD) earnings per share were $3.05 vs. $2.84 expected. Revenue came in at $30.46 billion vs. $30.03 billion expected. Same-store sales were up 8 percent globally vs. an increase of 6.6 percent expected.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly two-tenths of a cent at $2.857 reported open of $3.05, beating estimates calling for $2.84 per share.
